info.title: API-DocTest-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v3-spec
info.description: This API endpoint facilitates the retrieval of checkout information for e-commerce carts. It allows users to access the details of current and past checkouts, enabling better management of transactions and customer interactions. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and developers integrating checkout features into their applications. This functionality supports use cases such as tracking user purchases and analyzing cart abandonment rates.

get.summary: Perform checkout for the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate the checkout process for items in their shopping cart. It handles the necessary validation and prepares the cart for payment processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the checkout process for the items in the cart. It should include all necessary details about the cart contents and any user preferences for the checkout.

200.description: Checkout process completed successfully, returning relevant checkout details.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the checkout operation in the cart service. It is expected to be a string containing JSON formatted information related to the checkout process.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.title: Checkout Response

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the checkout transaction.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the checkout operation.

state.description: Current state of the checkout operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the checkout operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the checkout operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit log for the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure for the checkout operation.
